_doc: KAMPF_PLAN_1000 items 521-525 (scripts/overworld/WayfarerThemes.gd). Every Wayfarer has a theme: the element most of its team shares and a tactic. The tactic is the npc key "tactic", else profile_tactics of its AI profile, else default_tactic. arts: art kinds a Wayfarer with its own "tactic" key teaches its team on every difficulty, one per Spirling in team order. veteran_arts: from Veteran on every Wayfarer (no Warden, boss or wild horde, no own team block for that difficulty) teaches these instead, so the team plays together: "field" is the Resonance art of the team's element. tune: AI weights on top of the profile for a Wayfarer with its own "tactic" key. line: what the Wayfarer says at the start when its tactic is in play.

power.name: Brute force
power.line: No tricks. Just teeth. Some of them used to be someone else's.

field.name: Field tricks
field.line: The ground here owes me money. Watch it pay up.

status.name: Status tricks
status.line: I don't win duels. I make you lose them slowly.

stages.name: Stage tricks
stages.line: Give me three turns. You won't get a fourth.
